We need to return mapped_rxn and template_id (integer) for a template that when applied to the given molecule reproduces the SN2 reaction (break C-Cl, form C-N). The initial molecule: COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N)c1. This molecule contains a halide? Actually no Cl present. Wait SN2 reaction described: break halide functional group, form C-N. The target is to do retrosynthesis: we need a template that breaks a C-Cl bond and forms C-N. The molecule may have a C-Cl somewhere? The given SMILES doesn't have Cl. So maybe the retrosynthetic step is to introduce a leaving group (Cl) to a carbon that will be substituted by nucleophile (NH2). The template should be applicable to the molecule (maybe a protected amine). The search we did earlier with functional_groups_broken halide and formed primary amines gave template 1014069, which seems to be a reverse of amide formation? The mapped_rxn shows a transformation where a C-Cl is broken? Let's inspect mapped_rxn of template 1014069: It shows product side (right) has ...[NH2] etc. The left side (reactants) includes Cl[CH2]... So that template is a SN2: Cl-CH2-aryl + amine -> amine-CH2-aryl? Actually mapped_rxn: left side: [CH3][O][C]... plus Cl[CH2]... Right side: ...[NH2]... So yes it's a SN2 where Cl-CH2-aryl reacts with amine to give alkylated amine. So template 1014069 is appropriate.

We need to ensure that applying this template to our molecule reproduces the reaction (i.e., the template matches). We already checked matching? We didn't check. We should verify that the template matches the molecule. Use check_smiles_reaction_template_matching with template_id? The function expects template_id (string). We have template_id integer 1014069? Actually the search result gave reaction_id 1014069, not template_id. The template_id likely is the reaction_id? The problem says "template_id (the one used to search the database not the hash) as an integer". In search results, each entry has reaction_id. So template_id = reaction_id = 1014069.

We need to verify matching. Use check_smiles_reaction_template_matching with smiles and template_id? It expects template_id string. Provide "1014069".
